name: Conclusion Structural Pattern Analysis
description: Analyzes the internal rhetorical architecture of the concluding paragraph to detect rigid, template-driven synthetic endings.
algorithm: Tripartite Conclusion Parsing & Semantic Flow Profiling
mechanism: Large Language Models are aggressively fine-tuned on standardized, highly structured essay templates. When drafting a conclusion, they reliably execute a rigid, tripartite structural pattern: 1) A direct paraphrase or restatement of the introductory thesis, 2) A rapid, compressed distillation of the body paragraphs' main arguments, and 3) A broad, philosophical, or 'forward-looking' closing platitude (e.g., 'As society moves forward...', 'Only time will tell...'). Authentic human writers naturally exhibit vastly higher structural entropy in their endings; they may end on a poignant quote, an unresolved question, a sudden call to action, or simply stop immediately after their final point without explicitly 'wrapping up' the narrative arc. This method maps the semantic flow of the text's final segment, specifically hunting for the predictable 'Restate-Summarize-Generalize' architectural signature characteristic of RLHF-aligned AI output.
useCase: Detecting articles, essays, and long-form content that conclude with the sterile, highly predictable 'three-step' summary format typical of automated text generation.
strengths:
• Exceptional at catching 'high-effort' prompt outputs where the user removed obvious catchphrases ('In conclusion'), but the AI still retained its ingrained structural geometry.
• Highly effective on academic or formal texts where conclusions are expected, but human variance usually breaks the strict tripartite mold.
• Evaluates deep semantic flow rather than surface-level vocabulary, making it robust against simple word substitution.
limitations:
• Susceptible to false positives if analyzing lower-level student essays specifically written to conform to standardized testing rubrics.
• Completely blind to AI texts where the prompter explicitly provided a custom closing sentence or ordered the model to 'end abruptly'.
• Requires longer cohesive texts with distinct introduction, body, and conclusion phases to establish the mapped structural baseline.
parameters:
Analysis: Narrative Flow Mapping & Structural Entropy
Metric: Thesis-Restatement & Generalization Density
Output: 0-100 Synthetic Tripartite Structure Score
accuracy: High — 75-85%. Particularly lethal against 'informative' or 'educational' LLM generation. False positives occur heavily in structured student writing.

references.title: Jurafsky, D. & Martin, J.H. (2024). Speech and Language Processing. 3rd Edition.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. NeurIPS.
